text:
elaine: Quick sync — NovaRetail POC kickoff. Need to lock prompt inventory + success KPIs before Monday. Customer will validate with security then sign SOW. TL;DR: 3 flows to cover: support triage, product recommendations, order summarization.

sam: Sounds good. SE can own prompt baseline + eval harness. I can draft starter prompts for each flow. Any constraints on latency/cost? 🤔

elaine: Goal: p50 < 300ms for short support replies; p90 < 1s for product recs. Cost target: keep effective per-token cost <= $0.0009 if possible. Need token-level cost breakdown in the console.

raj: I'll own the eval criteria and checkpoints. Proposal: 50 labeled prompt-response pairs per flow (intent + success boolean), plus 20 adversarial examples. We'll run the eval harness and surface regressions.

marta: Heads up — NovaRetail requires redaction + KMS for PII. We need to answer the security questionnaire and include a threat model. For prompts, ensure test data has no real customer PII.

sam: Draft prompts below — quick starters, will iterate after SE review.

```support_flow
User: "My order says delivered but I didn't get it."
System: Extract order id, customer intent (missing delivery), suggest next steps and escalation path.
```

```rec_flow
User: "Suggest similar running shoes, size 9, budget <=$120"
System: Return 3 items ranked by relevance with short rationale and product ids.
```

ben: Can we include a reranking step and an eval for relevance? In past POCs rerank + reranking eval improved precision on recommendations.

elaine: @marta noted. Also customer wants the security questionnaire by Wed EOD. @sam please draft the "data handling" answers and I will route to legal.

sam: Quick question on model variants — customer prefers open models only. OK to propose a 7B quantized model as baseline + a hosted 13B fallback for hard queries? Any objections?

raj: That setup is fine. Add a failover policy: if p90 latency > 1.5s then route to fallback model and emit a metric. Also log model variant used per request for evaluation.

marta: Add to requirements: audit logs for model inputs/outputs retained for 90 days, and a redaction pipeline before logs persist. If they go private, KMS integration mandatory.

deploy-bot: Provision notice — POC env "nova-poc" provisioned on dev-dedicated-01. Console link and creds sent to @sam and @elaine.

sam: I'll build an eval matrix and upload the prompt inventory to the shared drive by EOD tomorrow. Need pair-labeling volunteers — @ben could you take product recs?

ben: Happy to. I'll also run an initial rerank baseline and share numbers.

elaine: Great — action items: sam -> prompt drafts + security Q answers; raj -> eval schema; marta -> security questionnaire draft; ben -> rerank tests. I'll own SOW + timeline. Sync Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
